# Japan Travel Ledger

English metadata: ./llms.txt
Chinese metadata: ./llms.zh-CN.txt
Canonical repository: https://github.com/Jason-Wu-7744/japan-travel-ledger
Releases: https://github.com/Jason-Wu-7744/japan-travel-ledger/releases
Language: English default documentation with Chinese companion pages; app UI and speech configuration are Chinese.
License: existing MIT License in ./LICENSE

## Summary

A native Android Java expense tracker for travel in Japan. Core text parsing, ledger storage, manual categories, daily/category summaries and CSV export operate locally. Current source also implements custom categories and JPY-to-CNY conversion with optional user-triggered rate refresh. Speech uses the selected Android system service.

## Source and release boundary

Source version: 3.0.0. As checked on 2026-10-25, the latest published release is v2.1.1 and the v3.0.0 release is a draft. Several early tags share 2.1.0 source. APK signatures, installation behavior and source correspondence are not independently verified. See ./docs/releases/README.md.

## Privacy and limits

- No ledger account, advertising, analytics SDK or app-managed ledger server.
- Android system backup is enabled and can include preferences, depending on device settings.
- A selected export document provider can be cloud-backed.
- System speech can use the network. Optional rate refresh contacts open.er-api.com without ledger fields.
- JPY is the ledger currency; CNY totals use the current selected rate rather than historical expense-time rates.
- Rule-based amount parsing needs confirmation for complex expressions and incidental numbers.
- No CSV import or app-managed synchronization.
- Java compilation and targeted numeric checks do not establish a full Android build or device compatibility.
